svg.title: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Desk; subtitle: Build evidence and filing readiness before forecasting near-term cash.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four weekly milestones cover Days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, and 22–30. The canonical first-deal planning range is 1–3 months; a signed engagement is distinct from a paid agency refund or settlement distribution. The first month targets authorized evidence, tested reconciliation, and complete packets, not collection of the annual Base revenue target.; caption: Launch with a small, traceable cohort and preserve the right to decline defective evidence before spending scarce specialist capacity.; stages: label: Days 1–7; value: Define lanes and appoint the core pod; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Contract the broker, analyst, and counsel; establish 25%–35% fee terms; configure separate recovery and revenue ledgers. Build statutory deadline fields, claimant identity checks, and court-specific disclosure templates. Allocate startup capital without assuming accelerated-payment access.; label: Days 8–14; value: Acquire authorized sample evidence; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Obtain source records from three pilot accounts, ideally one per lane. Reconcile a sample entry-to-export chain, a correction or protest candidate, and an existing settlement purchase ledger. Record actual evidence gaps and retrieval costs.; label: Days 15–21; value: Test eligibility and packet integrity; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Have the filing professional verify customs eligibility and clocks; have counsel verify settlement class and filer terms. Test duplicate detection, duty-component exclusions, export trace completeness, and fee calculations against source documents before valuing the pilot pipeline.; label: Days 22–30; value: Submit complete pilots and set cadence; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Submit only complete, authorized packets through the appropriate channel and capture acknowledgments. Set weekly exception triage, monthly cash forecasts, and account-level cost tracking. Carry pending claims as pipeline records, not realized recovery or earned operator fees.

text.title: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Desk
text.tspan: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Desk

circle.title: label: Days 1–7; value: Define lanes and appoint the core pod; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Contract the broker, analyst, and counsel; establish 25%–35% fee terms; configure separate recovery and revenue ledgers. Build statutory deadline fields, claimant identity checks, and court-specific disclosure templates. Allocate startup capital without assuming accelerated-payment access.

text.title: Define lanes and appoint the core pod

circle.title: label: Days 8–14; value: Acquire authorized sample evidence; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Obtain source records from three pilot accounts, ideally one per lane. Reconcile a sample entry-to-export chain, a correction or protest candidate, and an existing settlement purchase ledger. Record actual evidence gaps and retrieval costs.

label: Days 15–21; value: Test eligibility and packet integrity; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Have the filing professional verify customs eligibility and clocks; have counsel verify settlement class and filer terms. Test duplicate detection, duty-component exclusions, export trace completeness, and fee calculations against source documents before valuing the pilot pipeline.

label: Days 22–30; value: Submit complete pilots and set cadence; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Submit only complete, authorized packets through the appropriate channel and capture acknowledgments. Set weekly exception triage, monthly cash forecasts, and account-level cost tracking. Carry pending claims as pipeline records, not realized recovery or earned operator fees.

The canonical first-deal planning range is 1–3 months; a signed engagement is distinct from a paid agency refund or settlement distribution. The first month targets authorized evidence, tested reconciliation, and complete packets, not collection of the annual Base revenue target.
